title: Dent's homepage: choose the layout (his logo, red and blue stay as they are)
question: Pick one layout. All three use his logo, red #D8183C, blue #2470B4 and wide lettering.

options.label: The Arrow Loop
options.lineage: his logo's circle of red and blue arrows, turned into the page's backbone
options.thesis: The logo's loop becomes the visit: you call, Gerald comes, he fixes it, and it stays fixed.
materials: red heat arc and blue cool arc
options.viewport: A huge half-circle of the red and blue arrows wraps the headline and the phone number. The four stops on the arc (Call · Gerald comes · Fixed · Tune-up reminder) are real links into the page, and the request form sits inside the circle.
options.risk: The loop has to work as a path, not decoration, or it becomes a big logo.

options.label: Heat | Cool
options.lineage: the logo's own red-heat / blue-cool split
options.thesis: Two doors by symptom: red for 'my heat's out', blue for 'my AC's out', each going straight to the call.
materials: full-bleed red field and blue field
options.viewport: The screen splits into a red half and a blue half, each a full working door with its symptom headline, call button and request link. A property-manager strip runs across the seam.
options.risk: Colour does a lot of work here. Labels must carry the meaning for colour-blind visitors.

options.label: The Directory Listing
options.lineage: the local phone-book page, reset in his red and blue on white
options.thesis: The site is Dent's listing: a display ad with a giant number, and every service a listing line.
options.viewport: A ruled page headed HEATING & AIR CONDITIONING · ST. LOUIS. Dent's boxed ad (logo, giant phone number, request form) takes most of it, and services run as dotted-leader lines ending in 'Call'.
options.risk: Can read as retro if the rules and type are timid.

regions.label: Dent's display ad: logo, giant number, form
